title: Validation of in Vitro Method for Anti-MCPyV Immunotherapy on Patients With Cutaneous Merkel Cell Carcinoma
official: Validation of in Vitro Method for Anti-MCPyV Immunotherapy on Patients With Merkel Cell Carcinoma of Skin
summary: The aim of the study is to test and validate in vitro a cell therapy approach for MCPyV+ Merkel Cell Carcinoma patients.

sites.f: Dermato-oncology Department, Ambroise Paré Hospital, APHP
